name: AuGroup (SHENZHEN) Cross-Border Business Co., Ltd.
summary: AuGroup (SHENZHEN) Cross-Border Business Co., Ltd. operates as an online retailer for furniture and home furnishings in the People's Republic of China, the United States, Other North American countries, other European countries Germany, and internationally. The company offers furniture and home furnishings, consisting of beds, bookcases, dressers, chests of drawers, vanity tables and vanity benches, food cabinets, sofas, and outdoor furniture; electric tools, such as power screwdrivers, air pumps, jump starters, and car vacuums; home appliances comprising refrigerators and juicers; and consumer electronics, including power banks, chargers, and cables.
